```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

from ldstats import DirichletConfusionMatrix

counts = {
    "tp": 28,
    "fp": 10,
    "fn": 6,
    "tn": 56,
}

prior_alpha = 1.0
n_simulations = 20_000
```

```{python}
cm = DirichletConfusionMatrix.binary(
    tp=counts["tp"],
    fp=counts["fp"],
    fn=counts["fn"],
    tn=counts["tn"],
    positive_state_label="hc",
    negative_state_label="no_hc",
    positive_observation="dhi",
    negative_observation="no_dhi",
    prior_alpha=prior_alpha,
    n_simulations=n_simulations,
)

prior_positive = np.linspace(0.001, 0.999, 200)
prior_states = np.column_stack([1.0 - prior_positive, prior_positive])


def summarize(samples: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
    return {
        "mean": np.mean(samples, axis=1),
        "q005": np.quantile(samples, 0.005, axis=1),
        "q995": np.quantile(samples, 0.995, axis=1),
        "q10": np.quantile(samples, 0.10, axis=1),
        "q90": np.quantile(samples, 0.90, axis=1),
        "q25": np.quantile(samples, 0.25, axis=1),
        "q75": np.quantile(samples, 0.75, axis=1),
    }


posterior_dhi = cm.posterior_state_distribution(
    state="hc",
    prior_states=prior_states,
    observation="dhi",
    size=n_simulations,
)
posterior_no_dhi = cm.posterior_state_distribution(
    state="hc",
    prior_states=prior_states,
    observation="no_dhi",
    size=n_simulations,
)

summary_dhi = summarize(posterior_dhi)
summary_no_dhi = summarize(posterior_no_dhi)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.8, 6.8))

series = [
    (summary_dhi, "DHI observed", "tab:green"),
    (summary_no_dhi, "No DHI observed", "tab:red"),
]

ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle="--", color="0.4", linewidth=1.2, label="x = y")

for summary, label, color in series:
    ax.fill_between(
        prior_positive,
        summary["q005"],
        summary["q995"],
        color=color,
        alpha=0.08,
        label=f"{label} 99% interval",
    )
    ax.fill_between(
        prior_positive,
        summary["q10"],
        summary["q90"],
        color=color,
        alpha=0.14,
        label=f"{label} 80% interval",
    )
    ax.fill_between(
        prior_positive,
        summary["q25"],
        summary["q75"],
        color=color,
        alpha=0.24,
        label=f"{label} 50% interval",
    )
    ax.plot(
        prior_positive,
        summary["mean"],
        color=color,
        linewidth=2.0,
        label=f"{label} mean",
    )

ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")
ax.set_xlabel("Prior P(hc)")
ax.set_ylabel("Posterior P(hc)")
ax.grid(alpha=0.25)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
